_: Canonical file-size limits. Enforced by .claude/hooks/check-file-size-guard.mjs (pre-commit + CI) and pinned into .coderabbit.yaml by check-file-size-guard.update.test.mjs. The guard grades SQL migrations and 'use server' files only; other TS/TSX files have no file-length cap (function length: code-style.md §3).

rules.note: EXCEPTION, applied by grandfathering rather than by a code branch: a migration whose content is a single unsplittable DDL object (one CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION plus its GRANT/COMMENT/DROP boilerplate) cannot be split — a plpgsql body does not span files, and single-function SECURITY DEFINER redefinitions run well past this cap. The range is NOT stated here: the first attempt said "~300-330" and was refuted by the `baseline` map three lines below it in this same file, from inception, through nine review passes — the exact defect this file exists to end, committed inside it. Derive it from `baseline` instead. Such files are listed in `baseline` below. The limit stays strict so a genuinely multi-statement migration that COULD be split by concern is still flagged.

Defined by the `'use server'` directive, NOT by living in an actions/ folder — a folder-based rule gets it wrong in BOTH directions: most over-limit files under an actions/ directory lack the directive entirely (pure helpers, several split out to obey THIS rule and saying so in their header), while several files that DO declare it sit outside any actions/ directory — note `settings/actions.ts` is a FILE named actions.ts, not a directory, and a path-substring test conflates the two.

_coverage: COVERAGE BOUNDARY: only files under supabase/migrations/ and files declaring 'use server' match a rule. Every other file, including .mjs, test and e2e files, is ungraded by this guard.
